BV1ctpX65Eez.ingredients: Shrimp paste, egg, sliced bread, peanut butter, butter and a little oil.
BV1ctpX65Eez.quantities: 1 bread slice cut in half and 1 egg. Shrimp-paste amount, oil and cooking time are unspecified.
steps: Thaw the shrimp paste until soft and pan fry it, with an egg beside it.
Place the two bread halves over the egg so they adhere, then turn.
Spread peanut butter, add a little butter to crisp the bread, add the cooked shrimp patty and close with gentle pressure.
Toast both sides until golden. Rest the sandwich raised on cutlery to reduce moisture underneath.
BV1ctpX65Eez.missing: Shrimp-paste formula, bread thickness, heat and internal doneness parameters are absent. Suggested cheese is not treated as actually added.

BV1ctpX65Eez.quantities: Microwave the milk for about 1 minute, targeting roughly 60°C as stated. Milk amount and wattage are unknown.
steps: Put milk in a tall microwave-safe glass and heat as described, about 1 minute toward 60°C.
Froth the warm milk and combine it with coffee. The tall vessel reduces splashing.
BV1ctpX65Eez.missing: The full frothing process and coffee-water-milk ratio are not shown. One minute does not guarantee 60°C with every microwave or milk quantity.

BV1ctpX65Eez.ingredients: Frozen udon, greens, prepared Cantonese beef brisket and its sauce, and water.
BV1ctpX65Eez.quantities: The udon used cooks for about 1 minute. Beef and liquid quantities are unspecified.
steps: Cook greens in water, add frozen udon and loosen it; the creator says this type needs about 1 minute.
Separately reheat the previously cooked brisket with its sauce.
Put noodles and greens in a bowl and top with beef and some braising sauce.
BV1ctpX65Eez.missing: The brisket recipe is not supplied here. Follow the cooking requirements of the udon product used. The added liquid is braising sauce, not milk.

BV1ESp76GEUN.ingredients: Prepared fish and its liver, ginger slices, salt and peanut oil. A dark finishing sauce is visible but not named.
BV1ESp76GEUN.quantities: Steam over high heat for 8 minutes. Fish weight, thickness and seasoning amounts are unknown.
steps: Arrange fish and liver on a plate, add salt, peanut oil and ginger.
Steam over high heat for 8 minutes, remove and drain some liquid from the plate.
Add a little of the dark finishing sauce shown.
BV1ESp76GEUN.missing: Fish species, liver preparation, sauce identity and timing start point are unspecified. Eight minutes describes the portion shown.

BV1ESp76GEUN.ingredients: Eggs, water, shrimp paste and soaked mushrooms visually identifiable as morels; dark finishing sauce.
BV1ESp76GEUN.quantities: 3 eggs, about 150 ml, with 300 ml water. Steam for 8 minutes at a lower heat than the fish.
steps: Beat the eggs with 300 ml water ladled out earlier. Keep the whisk or utensil low in the vessel to reduce bubbles.
Stuff prepared mushrooms with shrimp paste, arrange in a bowl and add the egg mixture.
Cover the bowl with a plate, cover the steamer and reduce the heat. Steam for 8 minutes.
Remove and add a little dark sauce as shown.
BV1ESp76GEUN.missing: Morels are identified visually rather than named aloud. Soaking, cleaning, salt amount, exact water temperature and finishing sauce identity are unknown.

BV1ESp76GEUN.ingredients: Minced beef, potatoes, carrot, garlic, salt, a little curry powder, coriander, scallions, spinach, oil and cooked rice.
BV1ESp76GEUN.quantities: Microwave potato and carrot pieces without water on high for 3 minutes. Cut carrots smaller than potatoes. Other amounts are unknown.
steps: Mince the beef. Dice potatoes and carrots and microwave without water for 3 minutes on high until partly cooked.
Fry garlic in a little oil, add beef and break it up, then add the vegetables and fry until the potatoes lightly brown.
Season with salt and a little curry powder, add coriander, scallions and chopped spinach, and cook through.
Mix into cooked rice and portion.
BV1ESp76GEUN.missing: Beef weight, curry quantity, microwave wattage and whether spinach was pre-blanched are unstated. The visible coriander is not replaced by the ASR's mistaken lettuce.

BV1ESp76GEUN.quantities: Portion weight and storage time are unspecified.
steps: The video divides frozen shrimp paste with a serrated knife so only one portion needs thawing at a time.
BV1ESp76GEUN.missing: No homemade paste recipe, resealing details or storage limit is given. Keep packaging fragments out of the food.

BV1hWp76FEXo.ingredients: Beef brisket or rib strips, chu hou sauce, peanut butter, soy sauce, ginger and strained beef cooking liquid.
BV1hWp76FEXo.quantities: 2 spoons chu hou sauce, a small lump of peanut butter, about 2 circles of soy sauce and 1 piece of ginger. Pressure cook on low for 20 minutes after steam appears.
steps: Cut and blanch the beef. The original cooking liquid is strained and retained.
Return beef to the pot with chu hou sauce, peanut butter, soy sauce, retained liquid and ginger. No extra salt is added in this demonstration.
Close the pressure cooker and reduce to low after steam appears. Cook 20 minutes and depressurize according to the appliance before opening.
BV1hWp76FEXo.missing: Meat weight, spoon capacity, liquid quantity and cooker model are unknown. Two circles of soy sauce is not a defined volume.

BV1hWp76FEXo.ingredients: The brisket made in this video, rice noodles, greens, beef cooking broth and braising sauce.
BV1hWp76FEXo.quantities: Noodle and broth quantities and noodle cooking time are unspecified.
steps: Cook rice noodles and greens and divide into bowls.
Add hot beef broth, the cooked brisket and a little braising sauce.
BV1hWp76FEXo.missing: Exact noodle type, cooking duration and the broth-sauce ratio are absent.

BV1hWp76FEXo.ingredients: Rolled rice noodles, soy sauce, a little oil, this video's cooked brisket and cooked greens. The Cantonese name does not mean pork intestines are used.
BV1hWp76FEXo.quantities: Amounts and frying time are unspecified.
steps: Cut the rice rolls and mix with a little soy sauce for color and flavor.
Spread in a lightly oiled pan and sear, turning occasionally until lightly browned.
Add hot brisket, a little braising sauce and cooked greens, heat through and serve.
BV1hWp76FEXo.missing: The rice-roll recipe, pan temperature and cooking time are not supplied.

BV1oJpg6UE4K.ingredients: Sliced beef, shrimp, button mushrooms, lemon zest and juice, black pepper salt and a little oil.
BV1oJpg6UE4K.quantities: Meat, shrimp and seasoning amounts are unspecified.
steps: Pan fry beef, shrimp and mushrooms in a little oil.
Once they change color, add lemon zest, black pepper salt and a little lemon juice, and cook through.
BV1oJpg6UE4K.missing: Any earlier beef marinade, weights and frying time are unknown. Eggs are prepared separately.

BV1oJpg6UE4K.ingredients: Eggs, black pepper salt visible while preparing the eggs, and a little oil.
BV1oJpg6UE4K.quantities: Egg count, oil and time are absent. The pan is heated first, then reduced to medium-low.
steps: Beat and season the eggs. Heat the pan, lower to medium-low and add a little oil.
Pour in egg, tilt to let liquid meet the pan and gently push set portions without constantly breaking them up.
When mostly set, finish with residual heat and serve.
BV1oJpg6UE4K.missing: Internal temperature and final doneness are unspecified. Residual heating depends on the pan and quantity and does not itself establish safety.
